translations.text: Our Lord has given Saint Peter power, so that he can save the man who puts his hope in him. Kyrie eleison, Christe eleison [Lord, have mercy; Christ, have mercy].
He also holds the gates of the kingdom of heaven by his word: he can let in there whomever he wants to save. Kyrie eleison, Christe eleison [Lord, have mercy; Christ, have mercy].
Let us all pray together aloud to God's beloved friend, that he may be willing to show mercy to us sinners. Kyrie eleison, Christe eleison [Lord, have mercy; Christ, have mercy].
